Your mission concept, detailed project plan, and preliminary orbital calculations provide a strong foundation for Part 2.","next_steps":["Implement the planned coverage trade-off study to address the swath width versus revisit time constraint identified in your preliminary orbital analysis.","Incorporate the detailed payload mass, power, and data volume budgets into your next iteration to build upon the preliminary progress.","Maintain the professional IEEE citation standard and high-quality tabular formatting throughout the final report."],"criteria":{"C1":"You achieved the Accomplished level by presenting clear, quantifiable goals, requirements, and user needs (GBRMPA, AIMS, CSIRO, BoM) directly supported by relevant literature.","C2":"You achieved the Accomplished level with a robust Gantt chart, explicit requirement-linked tasks, credible information sources, and strong risk contingencies in Table 1.","C3":"You achieved the Accomplished level by pairing rigorous hand calculations for a sun-synchronous orbit with STK verification and insightful physical interpretation regarding swath width.","C4":"You achieved the Accomplished level through professional layout, clear tables, polished technical language, and impeccable IEEE referencing with matching in-text citations."}}
